# lexical item language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:lexicalItemLanguage`](gmeow-lexicalItemLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/lexicalItemLanguage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The primary language of a lexical item. Functional: one language per item (polyglot items are modeled as separate items linked by translation).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LexicalItem`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalItem.md) -> [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:lexicalItemLanguage`](gmeow-lexicalItemLanguage.md) from [`gmeow:LexicalItem`](../classes/gmeow-LexicalItem.md) to [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to fix the single primary language, variety, or state of a lexical item.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one language (it is functional) — model a polyglot or borrowed item as separate items per language linked by an [`EtymologicalDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-EtymologicalDerivation.md) or translation.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:lexicalItemLanguage`](gmeow-lexicalItemLanguage.md) once from the item to a [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) individual from the languages slice; mint a distinct item for each language a form belongs to.
